method: Independent Sage dense-matrix validation. For each arm, form C from every retained relation coefficient row, compute the right kernel of C^T over GF(262543), and for each kernel vector gamma with nonzero gamma dot b recover d=-(gamma dot a)/(gamma dot b). This does not use the incremental RelationRank implementation.
command_scope: Committed result.json files for n19 streams 202609104, 202609105 and 202609106.
verdict: All six independent kernel computations recover only 31415 from their one-dimensional dependency space.
scope: Validation of retained n19 relation matrices; not a runtime, novelty, or scaling claim.
